verification_scope: Final-source local verification. Every changed fixture passes in the complete suites. One unchanged Unix socket test is excluded locally after its socket creation was denied by the environment; it remains enabled in CI. This inventory does not qualify a real embedding model or the ten manual acceptance scenarios.
counting_rules: Count each new or revised executable test function once, independently of repeated invocations or parameterized subcases.
The crash child is a subprocess helper, not an independent fixture; its no-environment pass is not crash coverage.
Imported unchanged tests and existing tests selected by broad root filters are retained controls, never newly added fixtures.
The nineteen explicit process-termination subcases belong to one parent fixture and are enumerated separately.
Passed means the named root-run log recorded ok; pending includes unrun additions and tests needing rerun after an earlier failure or source correction.
